SHOT: Extreme macro, 4:5, of the two ends of the cuff: the clear square stone and the pink emerald-cut in their gold box settings, resting on the top face of a cream plaster cube. Camera very close; the piece fills about two thirds of the frame; razor-sharp on the stones and the metal edges, the rest falling softly out of focus.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority for the plaster, the background and the light only.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A SLIM OPEN CUFF BANGLE: a smooth round polished gold wire about 2mm thick, open at the front, its two ends side by side. One end carries ONE clear SQUARE cushion-cut stone in a four-claw gold box setting; the other end ONE PINK EMERALD-CUT (step-cut) stone, only slightly longer than it is wide and as wide as the clear square, in a four-claw gold box setting. Exactly two stones: one clear square and one pink emerald-cut rectangle; no pave; the wire is plain and smooth, never twisted; ONE cuff only.

SCALE TEST: The square stone is about 5mm and the emerald-cut about 5x6mm; the cuff is about 6cm across inside, about twelve stone widths, with about two stone widths between its two ends.

LIGHT: Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no ear, no model, no fabric, no props. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.

SHOT: A three-quarter profile portrait, the ear nearest camera sharp and centred, hair tucked behind it, the earring legible in frame. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: the ear, the jaw, the cheek below the nose, the neck, the collarbone and the shoulder. A cropped beauty detail, NOT a portrait.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn in the earlobe: EXACTLY ONE earring in this ear, through a single piercing, never two earrings stacked on the same ear; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A PAIR OF HEART STUDS: each stud is ONE gold tone HEART with a smooth, rounded polished rim around a recessed panel set with ten clear stones standing upright in five columns, each in its own collet: a top row of five BAGUETTES and a bottom row of a small SQUARE, three baguettes and a small SQUARE; edged with tiny gold beads; a single post behind. One heart per stud; eight baguettes and two small squares, never round stones, never pave; smooth gold rim; never more than one stud per ear.

SCALE TEST: On the lobe the heart is about 14mm, about a fifth of the ear's height and about two thirds of the lobe's width, its tip inside the lobe; never larger, never reaching the cheek. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
